entities.title: README and PLAN.md describe things the code no longer does
entities.summary: The README gives the old build folder, the old API path and several report offers a month; PLAN.md still calls the newsflash money quirk an open decision.
entities.expected: The README and PLAN.md say what the code and the owner's decisions say: the build goes into dist/games/retro/samosa/; the API is under /games/retro/samosa/api/; State Security offers its file once a month, at the month's end; the newsflash money quirk is switched off.
entities.observed: README, Develop: "bundle into dist/retro/samosa/". README, Deploy: the API is "under /retro-games/samosa/api/". README, How to play: "Several times a month State Security offers you its file". PLAN.md §4: the news money quirk "stays as an open decision".
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four statements matches build.mjs, worker/scores.ts, src/engine/flow.ts and docs/RULES.md §9.4.

origin.description: Found while reading the README and PLAN.md against the code for the .dev files.

sources.symbol: 9.4 The last costed item (an original quirk, switched off in the remake)

entities.title: Purge the old repository's history
entities.summary: The owner decided to purge it; which repository it is is not recorded here, and the purge rewrites and force-pushes every branch.
acceptanceCriteria: The owner names the repository and confirms the force-push.
No commit in it holds the faithful version.
